name: Fort Wilkins Historic State Park — West Loop
evidence: DNR West Campground map (fort_wilkins_camp_map.pdf): pull-throughs 142-158 and sites 161-179 on the lake side, but the loop road runs between every site and Lake Fanny Hooe; satellite z19 at 47.4664,-87.8742: pads ~10-25 m from shore past that road and a thin broken tree fringe, ~5 m above the lake (DEM 193 vs 188), so view, not on-water

name: Flowing Well Campground
evidence: rec.gov per-site coords (facility 232001, 6 sites, no Proximity to Water flag) on satellite z18: nearest pads 005/004/001 ~27-36 m from the Sturgeon River under continuous canopy; FS 'sites along the bank, overlooking the river' supports view only

name: Goose Creek State Forest Campground
evidence: old pin was the Goose Creek Trail Camp's open jack-pine loop (DNR: large open group area); DNR places the 9-site SFC at 44.75928,-84.84005 on the camp road by the Manistee; satellite z19: road ~20-30 m from the river behind trees, pads canopy-blind; DNR 'all nine sites have a view of the river', access across the road

name: Grass Lake State Forest Campground
evidence: satellite z18 at 44.5923,-85.8477: closed hardwood canopy, only the launch clearing by the Betsie River/Grass Lake Flooding is open, no pads resolvable; no per-site map (DNR or Colfax Twp); 'located on the flooding' plus ramp/carry-in access do not count, so default down

name: Haymarsh Lake Campground (Haymarsh State Game Area)
evidence: old pin was the entrance/group area by 140th Ave, re-pinned to the site road; county hand-drawn site map: sites 10-16, 19 on the lake side of the road atop a hachured bank; satellite z19 at 43.7614,-85.3606 canopy-blind, the road runs along a cattail marsh with open water farther out. No sightline shown -> coordinator kept not waterfront (default down; verifier proposed lakeview at low confidence)

name: Guernsey Lake State Forest Campground
evidence: satellite z19 at 44.7155,-85.3262 (OSM camp polygon on the north shore): closed canopy, the few visible pad clearings ~40-80 m from the water through trees; second OSM polygon on the east shore also canopy-blind; no DNR per-site map, so no upgrade; no legible contradiction to lakeview

name: Glidden Lake State Forest Campground
evidence: old pin was the entrance by the launch on Lake Mary Rd; DNR POI 46.06916,-88.23845; OSM camp_pitch nodes on satellite z19: nearest pads ~35-50 m from the east shore through trees and a reed fringe, canopy-blind; no per-site map, so no upgrade

name: High Bridge State Forest Campground
evidence: satellite z19 at 46.6072,-85.6014: site clearings (DNR POI 46.6076,-85.6013) ~50-95 m north of the Two Hearted River through dense forest; DNR says the banks are steep, access is 'challenging'; no per-site map
